feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 5 August 2026 4:06pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 05 August 2026 at 4:05pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low near the northeast of Scotland, moving to Scandinavia. High to the north of the Azores with an associated ridge to southeast Iceland, slowly transferring eastwards.


##Wind##

West or west-northwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the east of the area at first, decreasing 4 or 5 tomorrow morning, then easing west or southwest 3 or 4 during the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough in places at first, becoming slight or moderate, then mostly slight late in the period.


##Weather##

Scattered showers becoming isolated tonight, mainly fair later in the period.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, perhaps locally 5 at times, backing later on Friday afternoon to mainly south-southwest 4, but occasionally 5 in the west of the area.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
